summary: Listed only in one Georgia lookout index as a Stewart County tower at 32.21126, -84.80259; no build, fate or site record found.

evidence.supports: Index lists a lookout named black creek in Stewart County with its coordinates
Index is a list of Georgia lookout towers

notes_for_editor: Story is about 37 words, well under the 120-word floor, because the only source is one index row. Its elevation column has no unit label, so the brief's 157 m was not used. Searches of NHLR, FFLA, FFLOS, the Georgia Forestry Commission photo set on Wikimedia Commons, and the Stewart County Wikipedia page found nothing for this name. The index also lists a separate Stewart Lookout Tower (GA051) a few kilometres away, so keep the two apart. Recommend holding this record from publication until a second source turns up.
